Shuttle free, better than produce. Risk of border seizure? Shuttle gives grey goods, 25% risk without black tariff. But no tariff now. Still shuttle expected ~2.25 goods. Alternative: bribe to increase influence for the 5% bank commission bonus. Influence 3 vs 2 matters for presidential role and commission. Bank 30M + bid 20M = 50M; 5% commission ~2.5M extra to max influence. Bribe 5M costs 5M for +1 influence — marginal. Keeping presidency matters for veto over tax law. With influence 3 vs their 1, safe. Actually they could bribe too, but their next actions unknown.

Shuttle goods: sell price round 5 ~2 alashi each ≈ 6 alashi ≫ 5 alashi bribe? But shuttle risk 25% loss. Expected value of shuttle ~4.5 alashi revenue. Bribe 5M for +1 influence: helps keep presidency and commission. I already have influence 2 vs 1; likely enough. I'll take shuttle for goods.

Actually goods price: sold_counter 10, price 2. Round 5 selling 3 units lowers price further but ~6 alashi. Shuttle is best.
